title: DXOS scene ontology
description: Every type a stored drawing is made of, generated from the schemas in @dxos/scene.

Document.description: Scenes, layouts and models together. The first scene is the root.

Scene.Scene2D.description: A 2D scene as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.scene2d:0.1.0.

Scene.Scene3D.description: A 3D scene as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.scene3d:0.1.0.

Scene.Camera2D.description: Where a 2D scene looks and how far in.

Scene.Camera3D.description: An orbit camera. Angles are in degrees.

Scene.Layout2D.description: A 2D layout as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.layout2d:0.1.0.

Scene.Layout3D.description: A 3D layout as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.layout3d:0.1.0.

Scene.LayoutKind.description: A plain view, or the definition of a composite object.

Scene.GridPitch.description: A grid pitch in scene px.

Scene.Lattice.description: Lattice mode's grid: shapes span whole cells and links run in the gutters.

Scene.Constraint.description: Constrained mode's relation of one element to another.

Scene.Arrangement.description: How a layout places the elements that have no position yet.

Layer.description: A layer that elements paint on, bottom first.

Scene.Model2D.description: A 2D model as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.model2d:0.1.0.

Scene.Model3D.description: A 3D model as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.model3d:0.1.0.

Scene.Object2D.description: A reusable 2D object, with no position.

Scene.Object3D.description: A reusable 3D object, with no position.

Scene.StoredObject2D.description: A 2D object as a `Model2D` stores it.

Scene.StoredObject3D.description: A 3D object as a `Model3D` stores it.

Scene.BaseElement.description: The fields every element has, in either dimension.

ElementEndpoint.description: A link's end as an element stores it.

Scene.DslIdentity.description: The DSL statement that made an element.

PartLayout.description: How a part of a composite follows its frame on each axis.

PartConstraint.description: How a part follows its frame on one axis.

Scene.InstanceFit.description: How a placed composite maps its parts into its frame.

Scene.Dimension.description: The dimension of a scene, layout or model.

NodeBase.description: The fields every node kind shares.

BaseNode.description: A node whose kind is not known here: a box with a label.

EllipseNode.description: An ellipse inscribed in the frame.

ShapeNode.description: A shape that a named recipe draws from the frame and parameters.

PolylineNode.description: A line through points, in the 0 to 1 space of its frame.

PolylineBend.description: A segment of a polyline that runs as a curve.

HullNode.description: A border drawn round the nodes that name it as their parent.

ViewNode.description: A window onto a child view.

ViewLink.description: How a view node shows what it links to.

InstanceNode.description: A composite object placed in a scene.

PathNode.description: A vector shape from SVG path data.

GeneratorNode.description: A node whose content a generator computes.

DiagramNode.description: A shape of a laid-out diagram.

DiagramHeading.description: Where a diagram shape's heading sits.

DiagramShape.description: The diagram shapes a diagram node can hold.

BuiltinNode.description: Any node kind this package defines.

Port.description: An attachment point on a node's frame.

Side.description: A side of a node's frame.

Padding.description: Space between a shape's frame and its text.

Bounds.description: A rectangle by its top-left corner and size.

LinkBase.description: The fields every link kind shares.

OrthoLink.description: A link of horizontal and vertical segments.

CurveLink.description: A cubic curve that leaves each port along its normal.

SplineLink.description: A smooth curve through control points.

SmartLink.description: A link that is routed between its ends.

Endpoint.description: A link's end: on a node, or free at a point.

PortEndpoint.description: A link end on a node.

PointEndpoint.description: A free link end at a point.

LinkEnds.description: The markers at the two ends of a link.

Marker.description: What is drawn at a link end.

DiagramConnector.description: A link drawn as a diagram connector.

DiagramCaption.description: Where a diagram connector's caption sits.

Style2D.description: A 2D look: the node style and the diagram vocabulary.

Style3D.description: A 3D look: a material over a hue and a tone.

StyleClass.description: A named look that nodes and links take their style from.

StyleCatalog.description: A reusable set of styles, as an ECHO object. ECHO type dxn:org.dxos.type.scene.styleCatalog:0.1.0.

CatalogStyle.description: One style of a catalog: the 2D and 3D fields in one struct.

StyleHue.description: The hues the style pickers offer.

NodeTone.description: How strongly a hue fills a frame.

TextTone.description: How light or dark a text's hue is drawn.

ShapeBase.description: The id and style fields every diagram shape shares.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

Shape.Box.description: A closed shape in a bounding box.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

corners.description: Rects only: round just these corners (default all); backends without corner control ignore it.

autoCols.description: Size of each implicit column track.

autoRows.description: Size of each implicit row track.

justifyContent.description: Where the columns sit across the frame.

alignContent.description: Where the rows sit down the frame.

layout.description: How the box places its children.

parent.description: The grid that places this box.

width.description: Width the box keeps inside its grid cell.

height.description: Height the box keeps inside its grid cell.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

Shape.Polyline.description: A straight segment or a polyline.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

closed.description: Close the path back to the first point.

guide.description: A guide (lifeline, divider, outline) rather than a connector; layout checks do not count it as a route.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

points.description: Control points the curve passes through.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

Shape.Arc.description: A circular arc. Angles are in degrees.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

Shape.Arrow.description: A connector between two elements or points.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

head.description: Marker at the target end (default arrow): triangle for inheritance, crowsfoot for has-many.

tail.description: Marker at the source end (default none): circle for containment, arrow for a two-way connector.

path.description: How the connector runs between its ends (default `smart`).

relation.description: What the connector means; sets its markers: inheritance and implementation (hollow triangle at the target), composition and aggregation (filled or hollow diamond at the source, the whole), one-to-many (bar at the source, crow’s foot at the target), many-to-many, dependency (dashed, open arrow), association.

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

id.description: Stable element id, unique within the object (e.g. "left-eye"). Used to edit or delete the element.

ref.description: The drawing shown inside the box: an ECHO object reference (DXN).

border.description: Whether a closed shape draws its outline.

align.description: Where the shape's text sits across it.

valign.description: Where the shape's text sits down it.

Shape.BoxKind.description: The closed shapes a box can be.

Shape.Corners.description: Which corners of a rectangle are rounded.

Shape.Color.description: The colors of a diagram shape.

Shape.Fill.description: The interior of a closed shape.

Shape.Weight.description: Stroke weight and text size together.

Shape.Align.description: Where a shape's text sits across it.

Shape.VerticalAlign.description: Where a shape's text sits down it.

Shape.Layout.description: How a grid box places its children.

Shape.Place.description: Where grid tracks sit when they leave space over.

Shape.Path.description: How a connector runs between its ends.

Shape.ArrowHead.description: The marker at a connector's target.

Shape.ArrowTail.description: The marker at a connector's source.
